items.front: In AWS WAF, a login page gets brute force attempts from a few IP addresses. What do you add?
items.back: A rate-based rule in the web ACL.
items.extra: AWS WAF rate-based rules protect against use cases such as [brute force login attempts](../facts/waf.md#waf-faq-rate-based-web-layer-ddos).

items.front: AWS WAF or AWS Shield: which one inspects traffic at the request level?
items.extra: AWS WAF inspection: [Request-level](../facts/waf.md#waf-vs-shield-inspection-level). AWS Shield inspection: [Packet-level](../facts/waf.md#waf-vs-shield-inspection-level).

items.front: In AWS WAF, can you create the web ACL of a CloudFront distribution in Europe (Ireland)?
items.back: No. Create it in US East (N. Virginia).
items.extra: For a CloudFront distribution, you must [use the Region US East (N. Virginia)](../facts/waf.md#waf-cloudfront-web-acl-us-east-1) to create the web ACL and its rule groups and IP sets.

items.front: In AWS Shield, Shield Advanced costs {{c1::$3,000 per month}} for an organization, plus data transfer usage fees.
In AWS Shield, Shield Advanced requires a {{c1::1-year subscription commitment}}.
In Amazon VPC, the default quota is {{c1::20 rules per network ACL}}.
In Amazon VPC, workloads can connect only to approved domain names. Which firewall do you use?
items.back: AWS Network Firewall with a domain list rule group.
items.extra: Network Firewall supports [allow lists and deny lists with domain names](../facts/network-firewall.md#network-firewall-domain-allow-deny-lists) in its stateful rules engine.

items.front: In AWS Network Firewall, can a firewall endpoint protect the subnet that it sits in?
items.back: No. Put it in a dedicated firewall subnet.
items.extra: A firewall endpoint protects any subnet of the VPC [except for the one in which it's located](../facts/network-firewall.md#network-firewall-endpoint-not-own-subnet).

items.front: Shield Standard or Shield Advanced: which one gives 24/7 support from the Shield Response Team?
items.extra: A Shield Advanced subscription includes [24/7 support from the Shield Response Team](../facts/shield.md#shield-faq-advanced-layers-srt-cost-protection). To use it, you also need a [Business Support plan](../facts/shield.md#shield-srt-needs-business-or-enterprise-support) or Enterprise Support.

items.front: In AWS Organizations, the same AWS WAF rules must reach every account, including new ones. What do you use?
items.back: A Firewall Manager AWS WAF policy.
items.extra: When you add an account to the organization, [Firewall Manager automatically applies the policy](../facts/firewall-manager.md#firewall-manager-auto-applies-to-new-accounts) to its resources in scope.

items.front: In AWS WAF, Count or Block: which rule action lets evaluation continue to the next rule?
items.extra: After a Count match, [AWS WAF continues processing the remaining rules](../facts/waf.md#waf-count-non-terminating-continues) in the web ACL.

items.front: In AWS WAF, the most IP addresses or CIDR ranges that one IP set can hold is {{c1::10,000}}.
